perjuious.translation: 发假誓的, 作伪证的

perjure.definition: v. knowingly tell an untruth in a legal court and render oneself guilty of perjury
perjure.translation:
vt. 使发伪誓, 使作伪证, 使破坏誓言
[法] 作伪证, 发假誓

perjured.definition: v knowingly tell an untruth in a legal court and render oneself guilty of perjury
perjured.translation:
a. 作伪证的, 发假誓的
[法] 作了伪证的, 发了假誓的, 犯了伪证罪的

perjured witness.translation: [法] 作了伪证的证人, 作伪证者

perjurer.definition: n. a person who deliberately gives false testimony
perjurer.translation:
n. 伪誓者, 伪证者
[法] 犯伪证罪者, 发假誓的, 作伪证者

perjurers.definition:
plural of perjurer
n. a person who deliberately gives false testimony
perjurers.translation:
(perjurer 的复数) n. 伪誓者, 伪证者
[法] 犯伪证罪者, 发假誓的, 作伪证者

perjures.definition: v knowingly tell an untruth in a legal court and render oneself guilty of perjury
perjures.translation: v. 发假誓, 作伪证( perjure的第三人称单数 )

perjuries.translation: n. 假誓, 伪证, 伪证罪( perjury的名词复数 )

perjuring.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Perjure
perjuring.translation: v. 发假誓, 作伪证( perjure的现在分词 )

perjurious.translation:
a. 发假誓的, 作伪证的
[法] 伪证的, 假证的, 伪证罪的

perjury.definition: n. criminal offense of making false statements under oath
perjury.translation:
n. 伪誓, 伪证, 背信弃义
[经] 伪证, 假的证据
